name: Name
smartDesc: Your actions. One tap. Control your computer from your phone.
widgetsDesc: Quick actions at the screen edge. Hover to reveal your island.
floatingDesc: Your tools around your cursor, one shortcut away.
modulesDesc: Extend your workspace with modules. API v1 · JSON over stdin/stdout.
settingsDesc: Appearance, language and local server preferences.
variablesDesc: Shared macro values. Use ${name} in steps.
connectHelp: Connect your PC and phone to the same Wi-Fi. Open the Android app or web panel.
pairHint: Valid for 5 minutes and one device only.
panelHint: Drag to reorder. Click to select; use the buttons above to edit appearance or the macro.
label: Label
hoverHint: Hover the edge strip to open the island. Right-click a button for its settings.
radialHint: Press again or Esc to hide. Up to 12 items.
restartHint: Restart the app to apply a port change.
noModules: No extensions yet. Add a folder with manifest.json to data/plagin.
moduleHint: Enable only your own or trusted modules: they run with your user permissions.
notConnected: Connect your phone to your PC
controlHelp: Sliders and inputs pass a variable before running a macro. Toggles have a separate off macro.
macroHelp: Step values support ${variable}. PowerShell runs scripts literally.
removeMacroHelp: First remove references to this macro from all panels.
copiedHotkey: Copy disabled. Choose a different shortcut before enabling.
profileHelp: Export includes panels, macros, variables and appearance. Paired phones and access codes are excluded.
discardConfirm: Restore saved settings and discard current changes?
importConfirm: Import replaces the current profile in the editor. Macros can contain scripts: review them before saving. Changes take effect only after Save changes.
profileImported: Profile loaded into the editor. Review and save changes.
templateHint: Click a macro to copy its puzzles onto the canvas.
puzzleDraftHint: Visual draft — puzzle execution is not connected yet
dropPuzzleHint: Drag a puzzle from the left palette or click it
pluginCategoriesHint: Extensions can add their own puzzle categories here
fixedGridHint: Drag a button to any cell
rowOccupied: Row is occupied or it is the last row
gridSelectHint: One click opens appearance below. Edit macro opens the puzzle editor.
selectButtonHint: Click a grid button to change its appearance
galleryHint: Choose an image. Add your own backgrounds to data/image.
vectorSlugHint: Enter the exact brand identifier, such as github or python, or import a direct SVG link.
connectedHint: Only the branch from input runs. Text actions are enabled; other actions remain placeholders.
selectOutput: Select output for a new puzzle
sliderSettingsRequired: Slider maximum must be greater than 0 and at most 1,000,000,000.
transformRulesHint: One replacement per line: a - f or old word - new word. Exact, case-sensitive replacements run simultaneously on the selection. Leave the right side empty to delete.
standardEditOnly: Modern fields use Windows UI Automation. The field must expose TextPattern and selection support. Unsupported providers report an error in application.log.
textAutomationSupport: Modern fields use Windows UI Automation. The field must expose TextPattern and selection support. Unsupported providers report an error in application.log.
nearestFindHint: Selects the closest match on either side of the caret. Ties prefer the match after the caret.
winLoading: Detecting installed applications, terminals and audio devices…
winCommandHint: Detected on this PC each time the dialog opens. Runs hidden for up to 60 seconds. The output file is overwritten with stdout and stderr in UTF-8. Empty directory uses the app working directory.
winProgramHint: Detected from App Paths and the Start menu. shell:AppsFolder packaged apps do not accept arguments here.
winGlobalMediaHint: Controls the active Windows media player. These commands are not associated with an audio endpoint.
winAudioHint: Changes volume or mute on the selected device. A step of 5 means five percentage points.
winDefaultBrowserHint: Opens in the Windows default browser.
winActiveBrowserHint: Sends the command to the active browser window.
winKeysHint: Choose modifiers and a key. X-Mouse style categories; X-Mouse specific Layer/Movement/Action Tags are not executed.
winPressSpace: Move the cursor to the desired position, then press Space.
winCursorLive: Coordinates update live. Manual input stops tracking.
winCoordinatesRequired: Enter integer X and Y coordinates.
winPathRequired: Select a file, folder or application.
winCommandRequired: Select a terminal and enter a command.
winURLRequired: Enter an http:// or https:// URL.
winNoAudioDevices: No active devices of this type found. Check the connection and refresh the list.
missingMacroMessage: Macro file is missing. Create the macro first.
appSelectPanel: Select a panel in this mode.
appSelectVariable: Select a variable for each comparison.
appWaitHint: Waits until the condition matches. Rechecks every 100 ms while other macros can change variables.
appConditionHint: Exact, case-sensitive text comparison. A false condition stops this branch while other macros continue.
appParallelHint: Starts another macro in parallel. Button: click; toggle: true; slider: current variable value. Recursive calls are rejected.
appOp_or: Or: at least one comparison is true
connectedHintV9: Only the connected input branch runs. Text, Win, panel and app actions are enabled.
appLoopDisabled: Loops are disabled. Enable them in Settings.
appPhonePanelsOnly: Panel navigation is available only on the phone.
pluginUnavailable: Addon or its interface is unavailable.
reservedVariableName: Names containing __ are reserved for system and addon variables.
multiSelectHint: Click to select; Ctrl-click to select several; Shift-click for a range. Open settings with Change appearance above.
labelVariablesHint: Label variables: ${volume} ${system__time}. Combine multiple references and text.
sliderAfterHint: Off — activate after changing. On — activate at most once per interval; the final value is always sent.
splitHint: Each segment has its own input in the shared macro. Reducing the count removes trailing segments and their branches; the first segment remains.
occupiedRegion: Another button occupies this area — change cancelled.
mergeWarning: Choose one macro to keep. The selected buttons become one; their other macros are removed if no longer referenced elsewhere. Unselected buttons are preserved.
puzzleJoinCycle: This connection creates a cycle — cancelled.
puzzleJoinConflict: These blocks have conflicting branches. Disconnect extra edges first.
puzzleCanvasHelp: Middle button pans. Left drag on empty space selects a group. Delete removes it. Inputs are protected.
radialEditHint: Click to select; Ctrl/Shift for multiple selection. Right-click for actions and reordering.
